params.name: ma
params.let: r - d if k == 0 else (r if k == 1 else r + d)

params.name: opts
params.let: ['inside the circle', 'on the circle', 'outside the circle']

stem: M is the centre of a circle whose radius is $r = {=r}$ cm. A is a point with $MA = {=ma}$ cm. What is the position of A with respect to the circle?
solution: Compare MA with the radius: $MA = {=ma}$ cm and $r = {=r}$ cm.
If MA < r the point is inside the circle; if MA = r it is on the circle; if MA > r it is outside the circle.

distractors.text: at the centre of the circle

notes: Basic: compare MA with r. Options are shuffled by the engine presumably; stem numbers vary the instances.
